general.title: GSEA Filter
general.instructions:
Filter GSEA enrichment results from OMIX GSEA by p-value, enrichment score, pathway size, and more.

**Input options:**
- Upload a CSV file directly, OR
- Use the attached demo data asset, OR
- Replace the data asset with your own

**Interactive HTML table output** includes clickable MSigDB pathway links and column filters for exploration.

datasets.name: GSEA Results
datasets.help_text: Demo data asset containing gsea_results.csv from OMIX GSEA. Replace with your own or upload a file below (upload takes priority).

categories.name: Input Data
categories.help_text: Upload your GSEA results and select experimental contrasts

categories.name: Statistical Filters
categories.help_text: Filter by statistical thresholds and top-ranked pathways

categories.name: Annotation Filters
categories.help_text: Filter by pathway collections, specific pathways, or genes

parameters.name: Upload GSEA Results File
parameters.help_text: Upload a CSV file containing GSEA results (gsea_results.csv format). **Takes priority over attached data assets.**

parameters.name: Contrast Filter Mode
parameters.help_text:
**none** = include all contrasts
**keep** = include only specified contrasts
**remove** = exclude specified contrasts

parameters.name: Contrasts
parameters.help_text:
Comma-separated contrast names for keep/remove mode.
Example: `Treatment_1-Control,DrugA-Control`

parameters.name: P-value Type
parameters.help_text:
**adjusted p-value (RECOMMENDED)** = FDR-corrected, accounts for multiple testing in GSEA Preranked
**raw p-value** = uncorrected, use only for specialized analyses

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.help_text: Maximum p-value to include (e.g., 0.05 for 5% FDR). Pathways with p-value ≤ threshold are kept.

parameters.name: Enrichment Score Type
parameters.help_text:
**NES** = normalized (recommended for comparison across datasets)
**ES** = raw enrichment score

Set threshold = 0 to disable enrichment score filtering.

parameters.name: Enrichment Score Threshold
parameters.help_text:
Minimum **absolute** enrichment score (|NES| or |ES|).

**0 = no filtering** (include all scores)
**1.5 = typical threshold** for strong enrichment

parameters.name: Enrichment Direction
parameters.help_text:
**+/-** = both positive and negative enrichment
**+** = positive enrichment only (upregulated)
**-** = negative enrichment only (downregulated)

parameters.name: Size Filter Type
parameters.help_text:
**Pathway size** = total genes in pathway
**Leading Edge size** = core enriched genes

Set minimum = 0 to disable size filtering.

parameters.name: Minimum Size
parameters.help_text:
Minimum pathway or leading edge size (number of genes).

**0 = no filtering**
**15 = typical minimum** to exclude very small gene sets

parameters.name: Top Rank Filter
parameters.help_text:
Keep top N pathways per collection and contrast, ranked by p-value.

**all** = keep all pathways (case-insensitive)
**10** = keep top 10 per collection/contrast
**25** = keep top 25 per collection/contrast

parameters.name: Collections to Include
parameters.help_text:
Comma-separated MSigDB collection names (case-sensitive).

Examples:
- `H` = Hallmark gene sets
- `C2` = Curated gene sets
- `H,C2,C5` = multiple collections
- Empty = all collections

parameters.name: Pathways to Include
parameters.help_text:
Comma-separated pathway names to include (case-sensitive).

Example: `HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS,HALLMARK_P53_PATHWAY`

Empty = all pathways

parameters.name: Gene Filter Universe
parameters.help_text:
Where to search for specified genes:

**Leading Edge** = core enriched genes (recommended)
**Pathway** = all genes in the gene set

parameters.name: Genes to Include
parameters.help_text:
Comma-separated gene symbols (case-sensitive).

Example: `TP53,BRCA1,EGFR`

Keeps pathways containing **any** of the specified genes in the selected universe (leading edge or pathway).

Empty = all genes
